content.summary: Technology distribution company ScanSource (NASDAQ:SCSC) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales falling 4.6% year on year to $739.7 million. On the other hand, the company’s full-year revenue guidance of $3.2 billion at the midpoint came in 0.6% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.06 per share was 14% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
